item.title: ‘Can’t do it’: Jake, Spike weigh in on skyrocketing costs of youth athletics
item.description: A family raised concerns about the expensive costs for their child to play youth sports, roughly $16,000 a year for their son to play baseball with his team.

item.title: MSF suspends some work at Gaza’s Nasser Hospital due to presence of armed men
item.description: TEL AVIV, Israel (AP) — Doctors Without Borders has announced the suspension of some operations at one of Gaza ‘s largest functioning hospitals after patients and staff reported seeing armed, masked men roaming parts of the building. item.title: US ocean regulator faces criticism over changes to right whale protection rule
item.description: PORTLAND, Maine (AP) — The U.S.’s ocean regulator plans to make industry-friendly changes to a longstanding rule designed to protect vanishing whales, prompting criticism from environmental groups who cite the recent death of an endangered whale. The rules protect the North Atlantic right whale, which numbers less than 400 and lives off the East Coast. […]

item.description: Fire crews in Renton found a person dead inside a home that caught fire on Friday evening.

item.title: Kansas man charged in connection with officer-involved shooting in Ballard
item.description: King County prosecutors have charged a 62-year-old Kansas man in connection with Thursday night's shooting in Ballard involving Seattle Police Department (SPD) officers, according to court documents.
